question: Should this PR establish most-specific-prefix reload matching as the compatibility contract for overlapping config reload rules?
rationale: The code path and tests support the browser-profile fix, but the precedence change affects the generic reload planner rather than only the browser plugin, so maintainer intent should settle that merge risk before landing.

options.title: Accept Most-Specific Precedence
options.body: Update the docs carve-out and land this if maintainers want the generic reload planner to prefer the narrowest matching prefix.

options.title: Narrow The Precedence Change
options.body: Rework the implementation if maintainers only want browser/plugin reload metadata to override broad restart prefixes without changing the whole planner contract.

options.title: Keep Browser Profiles Restart-Scoped
options.body: Close or pause the PR if maintainers decide browser profile edits should still force gateway restarts despite the linked session-disruption reports.

recommendation.title: Accept Most-Specific Precedence
recommendation.body: Update the docs carve-out and land this if maintainers want the generic reload planner to prefer the narrowest matching prefix.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history across browser plugin ownership, browser config refresh behavior, and relevant docs.
